subject: SeedLab: onboarding credits & packaging for cohort startups
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@seedlab.org>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: apply@seedlab.org
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SeedLab: onboarding credits & packaging for cohort startups

Hi Neha,

We're kicking off our next SeedLab cohort (starts Sept 15) and a few of our teams are evaluating Redwood for early product work. Before we run demos I wanted to clarify how your startup onboarding credits and any promo exceptions work — specifically: 

- Is there a standard onboarding credit amount for accelerator cohorts?
- Do credits apply to embeddings and fine-tuning or only generation tokens?
- Are there limits per company vs per program (we have 12 companies) and any possibility for pooled credits?

We may need a small exception to the standard promo (we're working with a founder who will be in-residence full time and expects higher token usage during a 6-week concentrated build). Attaching our standard SOW for context.

Appreciate a quick note on options and any internal approval steps we should expect.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Program Director | SeedLab Accelerator
[Attachment: SeedLab_SOW.pdf (pdf)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@seedlab.org>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SeedLab: onboarding credits & packaging for cohort startups

Hi Elena — great to hear about the cohort, congrats on the launch. Short answers up front, full details below: 

- Standard cohort onboarding credit: 50k tokens per company (applies to text generation + embeddings).
- Fine-tuning/weights: credits do not cover customer-hosted fine-tune compute; we can offer a small add-on credit pool for supervised eval runs on hosted models.
- Pooling: we can create a pooled promo for the program (recommended for cohorts) with per-company caps.

We can support an exception for high-usage residency cases — typically we do a temporary uplift (additional 100k token credit for the specific company) but that requires a short approval from our Promotions committee. If you want, I can start that approval flow; pinged Aditya and Ben to scope contract/comms next steps.

Full details and next steps:
1) Standard package: 50,000 free token-equivalents applied on sign-up; includes embeddings and streaming generation.
2) Pooling option: SeedLab can receive a shared pool (e.g., 1M tokens) with an admin dashboard + per-company ledger; default per-company soft cap of 150k unless you request different.
3) Residency exception: we can provision an extra 100k-250k token credit for an individual company for up to 8 weeks; needs Promotions committee OK and an internal notice (billing/CS) so we track spend.
4) Billing & visibility: we provide per-token usage reports and an opt-in to set hard caps so you don't get surprised.

If you can confirm the program-level desired structure (per-company credit vs pooled + any residency candidates) I'll draft a short amendment and a promo request for the committee.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

---
Note: attached a sample credits spreadsheet I use when modeling program economics.
[Attachment: proposed-credits-structure.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@seedlab.org>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:26:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SeedLab: onboarding credits & packaging for cohort startups

Looping in to confirm we can fast-track a one-off residency uplift. Policy nutshell: promotions committee signs off for credits > 150k per company or pools > 750k. Given this is a program partnership and the residency is time-bound, I'm okay approving an extra 150k token uplift for the named company (trial) — conditioned on a short co-marketing note and a signed SOW amendment.

Neha — please draft the promo request with: company name, expected 8-week window, proposed uplift (we recommend 150k), and the co-marketing blurb (two-sentence). Ben — can you prepare a billing note to ensure the uplift is tracked to the SeedLab partnership code?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@seedlab.org>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SeedLab: onboarding credits & packaging for cohort startups

Hi Neha/Aditya — thank you, that sounds good and fast.

Confirmed: we'll do a pooled program credit of 1,000,000 tokens with a default per-company soft cap of 150k, and one residency candidate (DeepSight Labs) to receive the 150k uplift during their 6-week in-residence sprint (Aug 10–Sept 20 window). Attached our SOW and the candidate's expected timeline.

Next steps per your note:
- Neha: draft the promo request and SOW amendment (we prefer the uplift be applied on Aug 9).
- Ben: billing code and tracking confirmation.
- Aditya: co-marketing blurb — we can commit to a 2-sentence quote and a logo placement on the cohort page.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get teams building on Redwood.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Program Director | SeedLab Accelerator
[Attachment: DeepSight_SprintPlan.pdf (pdf)]
